purpose: choose theta for UJIIndoorLoc before the full 6-fold dev search (theta = 10% costs about 25 minutes of mining per fold)
data: dev folds 1 and 2 of GroupKFold(6) over USERID on trainingData; validationData not used
scorer: best over gamma/tau, beta, sigma, kf=3|10, m, p, with the floor-first rule
decision: theta = 20%, dev folds = leave-phones-out; internal utility chosen among abs / rel / rank on those folds
per_cell_budget: 10 s or 10 000 HUIs, theta x 1.25 on overflow
